<script>
  // Intro logos (tablet + desktop, written by Claude): copy the six logos so the track holds LOGO_SETS sets and the native
  // "Logo Track Desktop" scroll interaction (yPercent -94 -> -38 across the whole intro) never runs out - it reads as an
  // endless marquee. Runs before Webflow's interactions start. Copies are hidden from screen readers. Phones keep the original set.
  (function () {
    var LOGO_SETS = 6; // the interaction's yPercent values assume 6
    if (!window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)').matches) return;
    var track = document.querySelector('.logo-track');
    if (!track) return;
    var originals = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children);
    for (var k = 1; k < LOGO_SETS; k++) {
      originals.forEach(function (el) {
        var c = el.cloneNode(true);
        c.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        if (c.tagName === 'IMG') c.setAttribute('alt', '');
        track.appendChild(c);
      });
    }
  })();
</script>
<script>
  // Ticker: nine-row scroll marquee - drag + scroll-tied highlight sweep (written by Claude).
  // The sideways drift is the native "Ticker Drift" scroll interaction (xPercent on each .ticker__track).
  // This script: copies each row's sectors SETS times so the rows never run out, lets each row be dragged/flicked
  // (it moves the plain wrapper div inside .ticker__row, so it never fights the interaction), and runs the highlight:
  // tied to scroll, raspberry works its way along each line, left to right across the screen, one row after another
  // top to bottom. Letters that have been reached stay lit; scrolling back up un-lights them in reverse.
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // --- SETTINGS ---
    const SETS = 6; // copies of each row's sectors (the Ticker Drift xPercent values assume 6)
    const FRICTION = 0.94; // how quickly a flick slows down (0-1, higher = longer glide)
    const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 4; // px before a press counts as a drag
    // The sweep runs across this part of the section's scroll (0 = section top reaches the screen top,
    // 1 = section bottom reaches the screen bottom). Desktop: the panel slides in over 0-1/3, holds 1/3-2/3, slides out 2/3-1.
    const SWEEP_DESKTOP = [0.3, 0.7];
    const SWEEP_SMALLER = [0.1, 0.9]; // tablet / phone (no wipe)

    const section = document.querySelector('[data-mwp-sequence]') || document.querySelector('.ticker');
    const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ticker__row'));
    if (!section || !rows.length) return;
    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');

    // The separator's en dash is source text over its gradient bar; hide the glyph but retain the bar and separator for assistive text.
    document.querySelectorAll('.ticker__item .dash').forEach((dash) => {
      dash.style.color = 'transparent';
    });

    // Split each sector's text into letters
    document.querySelectorAll('.ticker__item > div').forEach((word) => {
      word.classList.add('ticker__word');
      Array.from(word.childNodes).forEach((n) => {
        if (n.nodeType !== 3) return;
        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        for (const c of n.textContent) {
          const s = document.createElement('span');
          s.className = 'ticker__ch';
          s.textContent = c;
          frag.appendChild(s);
        }
        n.replaceWith(frag);
      });
    });

    const state = rows.map((row) => {
      const drag = row.firstElementChild;
      const track = row.querySelector('.ticker__track');
      const originals = Array.from(track.children);
      for (let k = 1; k < SETS; k++) {
        originals.forEach((el) => {
          const c = el.cloneNode(true);
          c.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          track.appendChild(c);
        });
      }
      drag.style.willChange = 'transform';
      // visible letters only (spaces don't light); x = each letter's centre measured from the track's left edge
      const chars = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('.ticker__ch'))
        .filter((c) => c.textContent.trim())
        .map((el) => ({ el, x: 0, on: false }));
      return { row, drag, track, chars, x: 0, vel: 0, setW: 0 };
    });

    function measure() {
      state.forEach((s) => {
        s.setW = s.track.scrollWidth / SETS;
        const t = s.track.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        s.chars.forEach((c) => {
          const r = c.el.getBoundingClientRect();
          c.x = r.left + r.width / 2 - t;
        });
      });
    }
    function wrap(s) {
      // keep the drag offset within half a set either way - the copies make the jump invisible
      if (!s.setW) return;
      const h = s.setW / 2;
      s.x = ((((s.x + h) % s.setW) + s.setW) % s.setW) - h;
    }
    function render(s) {
      s.drag.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + s.x + 'px,0,0)';
    }

    // -- Drag --
    state.forEach((s) => {
      let pressed = false,
        dragging = false,
        startX = 0,
        lastX = 0,
        lastT = 0;
      s.row.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;
        pressed = true;
        startX = lastX = e.clientX;
        lastT = performance.now();
        s.vel = 0;
      });
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!pressed) return;
        if (!dragging && Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) > DRAG_THRESHOLD) {
          dragging = s.dragging = true;
          s.row.setPointerCapture && s.row.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
          s.row.classList.add('is-dragging');
        }
        if (!dragging) return;
        const now = performance.now();
        const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
        s.x += dx;
        s.vel = (dx / Math.max(now - lastT, 1)) * 16.67;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        lastT = now;
        wrap(s);
        render(s);
      });
      const release = () => {
        pressed = false;
        if (!dragging) return;
        dragging = s.dragging = false;
        s.row.classList.remove('is-dragging');
        if (performance.now() - lastT > 80) s.vel = 0; // held still before letting go = no flick
      };
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
    });

    // -- Highlight sweep --
    function sweepProgress() {
      // 0 -> rows.length: whole number = rows fully lit, fraction = how far along the current row the sweep is
      const r = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const range = r.height - window.innerHeight;
      const p = range > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / range)) : 0;
      const [a, b] = desktop.matches ? SWEEP_DESKTOP : SWEEP_SMALLER;
      return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p - a) / (b - a))) * state.length;
    }
    function sweep() {
      const P = sweepProgress(),
        vw = window.innerWidth;
      const middle = (state.length - 1) / 2;
      state.forEach((s, k) => {
        const distance = Math.abs(k - middle);
        const rank = k === middle ? 0 : k < middle ? distance * 2 - 1 : distance * 2 - 2;
        const rowP = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, P - rank));
        // each row lights from the viewport centre out towards both edges
        const reach = rowP * vw / 2;
        const t = s.track.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        s.chars.forEach((c) => {
          const on = Math.abs(t + c.x - vw / 2) <= reach;
          if (on !== c.on) {
            c.on = on;
            c.el.classList.toggle('is-on', on);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    // -- Loop (only while the section is on screen) --
    let visible = false;
    let prev = performance.now();
    function tick(now) {
      const dt = Math.min(now - prev, 50) / 1000;
      prev = now;
      if (visible) {
        state.forEach((s) => {
          if (!s.dragging && s.vel) {
            s.x += s.vel * dt * 60;
            s.vel *= Math.pow(FRICTION, dt * 60);
            if (Math.abs(s.vel) < 0.05) s.vel = 0;
            wrap(s);
            render(s);
          }
        });
        sweep();
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      new IntersectionObserver((entries) => (visible = entries[0].isIntersecting)).observe(section);
    } else visible = true;

    let rt;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(rt);
      rt = setTimeout(measure, 150);
    });
    (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
      measure();
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
  })();
</script>
<script>
  // Pricing (desktop): tied to scroll while the section is locked (written by Claude - Webflow interactions can't animate clip-path).
  // This script ONLY animates the colour shapes. Progress p runs 0 -> 1 across the lock. 0-0.15: the colour thirds drop
  // down from the separator; 0.15-0.32: they tighten into the cards (each card 0.025 behind the one to its left).
  // Everything else - the card text fading up (0.28-0.40), the cards pushing off left and the CTA sliding in (0.5-0.8) -
  // is the native "Pricing Section Desktop" interaction.
  // The card height fits the tallest card's content (not the full screen), and the block padding is set to match, so the
  // content always sits inside the card shape; prices sit on the bottom row (Pricing Block align-items: end).
  // Horizontal spacing: the three cards are equal widths with the same GAP_VW gap at both screen edges and between cards.
  // The thirds stay equal, so each card is cut from its third with its own left/right inset, and the block's side padding
  // follows that inset so the text keeps INNER_X_VW from the card edge.
  // Before its drop starts, each block is visibility: hidden as well as fully clipped. A clip sized from offsetHeight
  // (a rounded number) left a sub-pixel sliver - a faint line, or a thicker strip on some screens - showing early.
  (function () {
    var DROP_END = 0.15,
      FORM_END = 0.32,
      CARD_STAGGER = 0.025; // each card starts this much later than the one to its left
    var INNER_VW = 3,
      MIN_INSET_VH = 0.06,
      RADIUS = 48;
    var GAP_VW = 2.4; // gap at the left and right screen edges AND between the cards
    var INNER_X_VW = 2.4; // text inset from the card's left/right edge
    var s = document.querySelector('.pricing');
    if (!s) return;
    var wrapper = s.querySelector('.pricing-wrapper');
    var blocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(s.querySelectorAll('.pricing-block'));
    var kids = blocks.map(function (b) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(b.children);
    }); // only measured
    var desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');
    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var insetV = 0,
      cardH = 0,
      sides = blocks.map(function () {
        return { l: 0, r: 0 };
      });
    function clamp(x) {
      return x < 0 ? 0 : x > 1 ? 1 : x;
    }
    function ease(x) {
      return x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2;
    }
    function progress() {
      // the GSAP pin wraps the section in a .pin-spacer; its top moves 0 -> -sectionHeight across the lock
      var sp = s.parentElement;
      var host = sp && sp.classList.contains('pin-spacer') ? sp : s;
      return clamp(-host.getBoundingClientRect().top / Math.max(1, host === s ? s.offsetHeight : host.offsetHeight - s.offsetHeight));
    }
    function measure() {
      if (!desktop.matches) return;
      var vh = window.innerHeight,
        vw = window.innerWidth / 100;
      // horizontal first (it changes the text wrap, so the heights are measured after)
      if (wrapper) {
        var wr = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect(),
          g = GAP_VW * vw,
          cw = (wr.width - 4 * g) / 3,
          ix = INNER_X_VW * vw;
        blocks.forEach(function (b, i) {
          var br = b.getBoundingClientRect();
          var left = g + i * (cw + g); // target card edges, relative to the wrapper
          var l = left - (br.left - wr.left),
            r = br.right - wr.left - (left + cw);
          sides[i] = { l: l, r: r };
          b.style.paddingLeft = l + ix + 'px';
          b.style.paddingRight = r + ix + 'px';
        });
      }
      var inner = INNER_VW * vw,
        tallest = 0;
      kids.forEach(function (list, i) {
        var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(blocks[i]).rowGap) || 0,
          h = 0;
        list.forEach(function (k) {
          h += k.offsetHeight;
        });
        h += gap * Math.max(0, list.length - 1);
        if (h > tallest) tallest = h;
      });
      cardH = tallest + inner * 2;
      insetV = Math.max(vh * MIN_INSET_VH, (vh - cardH) / 2);
      blocks.forEach(function (b) {
        b.style.paddingTop = b.style.paddingBottom = insetV + inner + 'px';
      });
    }
    function clear() {
      s.classList.remove('js-form');
      blocks.forEach(function (b) {
        b.style.clipPath = b.style.paddingTop = b.style.paddingBottom = b.style.paddingLeft = b.style.paddingRight = b.style.visibility = '';
      });
    }
    function render() {
      if (!desktop.matches) {
        clear();
        return;
      }
      s.classList.add('js-form');
      var p = progress(),
        vh = window.innerHeight;
      // the block's real (unrounded) height plus 2px, so nothing peeks out before the drop
      var bh = (blocks[0] ? blocks[0].getBoundingClientRect().height : vh) + 2;
      blocks.forEach(function (bl, i) {
        var q = p - i * CARD_STAGGER; // raspberry first, then coral, then teal
        var a = ease(clamp(q / DROP_END));
        var b = ease(clamp((q - DROP_END) / (FORM_END - DROP_END)));
        if (reduce.matches) {
          a = b = p > 0 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        bl.style.visibility = a > 0 ? '' : 'hidden';
        var top = b * insetV,
          left = b * sides[i].l,
          right = b * sides[i].r,
          bottom = (1 - a) * bh + b * Math.max(0, bh - insetV - cardH),
          r = b * RADIUS;
        bl.style.clipPath = 'inset(' + top + 'px ' + right + 'px ' + bottom + 'px ' + left + 'px round 0px ' + r + 'px ' + r + 'px ' + r + 'px)';
      });
    }
    function refresh() {
      measure();
      render();
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', render, { passive: true });
    var rt;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      clearTimeout(rt);
      rt = setTimeout(refresh, 120);
    });
    if (window.lenis && window.lenis.on) window.lenis.on('scroll', render);
    refresh();
    (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve()).then(refresh);
    window.addEventListener('load', refresh);
  })();
</script>
<script>
  // Testimonials -> pixel speech bubble -> MWP heart loop (written by Claude, v2.2 24 Oct; v2.3 1 Nov: scrolling back up
  // from the heart spins back to the speech bubble instead of jumping, R-079). Every screen size.
  // 1. FLY-IN: as the Testimonial Wall starts tilting away, 42 of its bubbles fly into the pixels of the big logo
  //    (.mwp-logo-2) in the Contact section - arranged as a pixel SPEECH BUBBLE - straightening, squaring up and fading
  //    to the logo's opacity on the way, while the rest of the wall fades out (so nothing is seen cut off at the section
  //    edge). Tied to scroll, so it reverses when scrolling back up.
  // 2. LOOP: once it has landed (and whenever the Contact section is on screen), every HOLD_MS the pixels spin a full
  //    turn on their vertical axis while gliding to the other shape - speech bubble -> MWP heart -> speech bubble...
  // The logo in the Designer is still the heart (9 x 7 grid, 42 coloured pixels: 14 raspberry, 12 coral, 16 teal). The
  // speech bubble uses the same 42 pixels in the same colours; this script just moves each pixel into its bubble spot.
  // How the fly-in works: each logo pixel is paired with the nearest bubble of the same colour. A stand-in tile (in a fixed
  // layer inside .contact, so the form still paints above it) is blended from its bubble's live on-screen box to its
  // pixel's live box - both measured every frame, so the hand-off at each end is exact and you can move/resize the logo in
  // the Designer. While it runs, the chosen bubbles and their pixels are hidden; at the end the real logo takes over.
  // PHONES / TABLETS (below 992px) - v2.2: a TIMED fly-in instead. On a phone the page scrolls on its own thread and
  // anything a script moves in step with the scroll arrives a frame late, which reads as judder however fast the phone
  // is. So there it plays once, over FLY_MS, when the Contact section's top passes TRIGGER_AT of the screen: the tiles
  // ride along with the page (not the screen) and the browser animates them itself, so they stay smooth while scrolling.
  // The rest of the wall fades out at the same moment. Scrolling back up above REARM_AT puts the bubbles back for next time.
  (function () {
    'use strict';
    // --- SETTINGS ---
    var ENABLED = true; // kill switch: false = no fly-in and no loop (the heart just sits in the Contact section)
    var START_UNIT = 182; // Testimonial Wall timeline unit (of 192) where the fly-in starts - 182 = the wall starts tilting away
    var END_AT = 0; // the fly-in completes when the Contact section's top is this many screen heights below the screen top
    var SPREAD = 0.35; // fly-in stagger: 0 = every tile moves together; higher = the far-away tiles set off later
    var PICK_MARGIN = 0.25; // bubbles up to this many screen widths/heights off screen are picked first (widened if too few)
    var WALL_FADE = 0.55; // the rest of the wall has faded out by this point of the fly-in (0-1)
    var HOLD_MS = 4000; // loop: how long each shape holds
    var SPIN_MS = 900; // loop: how long each pixel's spin + glide takes
    var RIPPLE_MS = 500; // loop: left-to-right delay across the shape (the first pixel starts this much before the last)
    // Phones / tablets (below 992px): the timed fly-in
    var FLY_MS = 1200; // how long the whole fly-in takes (the stagger is SPREAD of this)
    var TRIGGER_AT = 0.5; // plays when the Contact section's top is this far down the screen (0 = top, 1 = bottom)
    var REARM_AT = 0.9; // scrolling back up until the Contact top is below this resets it, ready to play again
    var WALL_OUT_MS = 400; // the rest of the wall fades out over this
    // The speech bubble, row by row (columns 0-8 of the 9 x 7 grid). r/c/t = raspberry/coral/teal, . = empty.
    // Must keep 14 r, 12 c and 16 t so every pixel has a spot of its own colour.
    var BUBBLE = [
      '.rrrcctt.',
      'rrrcccttt',
      'rr.c.c.tt',
      'rrrcccttt',
      '.rrrcctt.',
      '......tt.',
      '.......tt',
    ];
    // ---
    if (!ENABLED) return;
    var testi = document.querySelector('.testi-wall');
    var contact = document.querySelector('.contact');
    var logo = contact && contact.querySelector('.mwp-logo-2');
    var stage = testi && testi.querySelector('.testi-wall_stage');
    if (!contact || !logo) return;
    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var small = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

    var wraps = Array.prototype.slice.call(logo.querySelectorAll('.pixel-3d'));
    var cells = wraps.map(function (w) {
      return w.querySelector('.pixel-2');
    });
    if (!cells.length || cells.indexOf(null) > -1) return;

    function colourOf(el) {
      var c = el.classList;
      if (c.contains('is-teal') || c.contains('px-teal')) return 't';
      if (c.contains('is-raspberry') || c.contains('px-raspberry')) return 'r';
      return 'c';
    }
    function clamp(x) {
      return x < 0 ? 0 : x > 1 ? 1 : x;
    }
    function ease(x) {
      return x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2;
    }
    function lerp(a, b, t) {
      return a + (b - a) * t;
    }
    function rgb(s) {
      // handles rgb(217, 70, 108) AND color(srgb 0.85 0.27 0.42) - the colour-mixed inner rows compute to the second form
      var m = s.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [0, 0, 0];
      var k = /^color\(/.test(s) ? 255 : 1;
      return [m[0] * k, m[1] * k, m[2] * k];
    }
    function radii(cs) {
      return [cs.borderTopLeftRadius, cs.borderTopRightRadius, cs.borderBottomRightRadius, cs.borderBottomLeftRadius].map(function (v) {
        return parseFloat(v) || 0;
      });
    }
    function matrixOf(el) {
      // rotation (deg) and scale of an element's own transform
      var t = getComputedStyle(el).transform;
      if (!t || t === 'none') return { a: 0, s: 1 };
      var m = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(t);
      return { a: (Math.atan2(m.b, m.a) * 180) / Math.PI, s: Math.hypot(m.a, m.b) };
    }

    // ---------- SHAPES: each pixel's heart spot (its place in the Designer grid) and its speech-bubble spot ----------
    var pitch = 18; // grid step in the logo's own px (cell + gap) - measured below
    var px = wraps.map(function (w, i) {
      return { w: w, col: colourOf(cells[i]), hx: 0, hy: 0, bx: 0, by: 0, x: 0, y: 0 };
    });
    function measureGrid() {
      var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(logo).columnGap) || 0;
      pitch = (wraps[0].offsetWidth || 16) + gap;
      var o = logo.children[0]; // the grid's first square (top-left) is the origin
      px.forEach(function (p) {
        p.hx = Math.round((p.w.offsetLeft - o.offsetLeft) / pitch);
        p.hy = Math.round((p.w.offsetTop - o.offsetTop) / pitch);
      });
      // bubble spots by colour, then pair each pixel with the nearest free spot of its colour
      var spots = [];
      BUBBLE.forEach(function (row, y) {
        row.split('').forEach(function (ch, x) {
          if ('rct'.indexOf(ch) > -1) spots.push({ x: x, y: y, col: ch, used: false });
        });
      });
      var pairs = [];
      px.forEach(function (p, i) {
        spots.forEach(function (s, j) {
          if (s.col === p.col) pairs.push({ i: i, j: j, d: Math.hypot(s.x - p.hx, s.y - p.hy) });
        });
      });
      pairs.sort(function (a, b) {
        return a.d - b.d;
      });
      var done = {};
      pairs.forEach(function (q) {
        if (done[q.i] || spots[q.j].used) return;
        done[q.i] = true;
        spots[q.j].used = true;
        px[q.i].bx = spots[q.j].x;
        px[q.i].by = spots[q.j].y;
      });
      px.forEach(function (p, i) {
        if (!done[i]) {
          p.bx = p.hx; // not enough spots of this colour: stays where it is in both shapes
          p.by = p.hy;
        }
      });
    }
    function place(p, gx, gy, spin) {
      // gx/gy = grid position (can be fractional mid-glide); spin = degrees around the vertical axis
      p.x = gx;
      p.y = gy;
      p.spin = spin || 0; // read by the fly-in tiles, so a spin still shows while they stand in for the pixels
      var dx = (gx - p.hx) * pitch,
        dy = (gy - p.hy) * pitch;
      p.w.style.transform = spin ? 'translate(' + dx + 'px,' + dy + 'px) perspective(120px) rotateY(' + spin + 'deg)' : dx || dy ? 'translate(' + dx + 'px,' + dy + 'px)' : '';
    }
    var shape = 'heart'; // what's showing (or being headed to)
    var anim = null; // running spin: { t0, from }
    function setShape(s) {
      anim = null;
      shape = s;
      px.forEach(function (p) {
        if (s === 'bubble') place(p, p.bx, p.by, 0);
        else place(p, p.hx, p.hy, 0);
      });
    }
    function startSpin(to, now) {
      shape = to;
      // v2.3 (R-079): glide from where each pixel is now, so a spin can turn back halfway without a jump
      anim = {
        t0: now,
        from: px.map(function (p) {
          return { x: p.x, y: p.y };
        }),
      };
    }
    function stepSpin(now) {
      if (!anim) return false;
      var allDone = true;
      px.forEach(function (p, i) {
        var fx = anim.from[i].x,
          fy = anim.from[i].y,
          tx = shape === 'heart' ? p.hx : p.bx,
          ty = shape === 'heart' ? p.hy : p.by;
        var delay = (Math.min(fx, tx) / 8) * RIPPLE_MS; // left-to-right ripple
        var t = clamp((now - anim.t0 - delay) / SPIN_MS);
        if (t < 1) allDone = false;
        var e = ease(t);
        place(p, lerp(fx, tx, e), lerp(fy, ty, e), t > 0 && t < 1 ? 360 * e : 0);
      });
      if (allDone) anim = null;
      return true;
    }

    // ---------- FLY-IN (desktop, tied to scroll) ----------

    const hideBars = document.createElement('style');
    hideBars.textContent = ['html.mwp-pt-run', 'html.mwp-pt-enter'].map((h) => ['.project-image-wrapper', '.folio-rte-wrapper'].map((c) => `${h} ${c}::-webkit-scrollbar-track,${h} ${c}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb`).join(',')).join(',') + '{background:transparent !important;border-color:transparent !important}';
    document.head.appendChild(hideBars);

    const nextPaint = () => new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));

    // Elements moving sideways are clipped by their scrolling box (the screenshot column), else by the window
    function clipBox(el) {

        if (/(auto|scroll|hidden|clip)/.test(getComputedStyle(p).overflowX)) return p.getBoundingClientRect();
      }
      return { left: 0, right: window.innerWidth };
    }

    function targets() {
      const vh = window.innerHeight;
      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(TARGETS))
        .map((el) => ({ el, r: el.getBoundingClientRect(), box: clipBox(el) }))
        .filter((t) => t.r.width > 0 && t.r.height > 0 && t.r.bottom > 0 && t.r.top < vh)
        .map((t) => ({
          el: t.el,
          key: t.r.left * 10000 + t.r.top,
          away: (side) => (side > 0 ? t.box.right - t.r.left + GAP : -(t.r.right - t.box.left + GAP)),
        }));
    }

      root.classList.add('mwp-pt-run');
      running = list.map((t, i) =>
        t.el.animate([{ transform: 'translateX(0)', opacity: 1 }, { transform: `translateX(${t.away(dir)}px)`, opacity: 0 }], { duration: DURATION, delay: i * STAGGER, easing: EASE, fill: 'forwards' }),
      );
      return Promise.all(running.map((a) => a.finished)).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Arriving: slide in from the side opposite to `dir`, the elements nearest that edge first
    function enter(dir) {
      const list = targets().sort((a, b) => (dir > 0 ? a.key - b.key : b.key - a.key));
      const images = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.project-page-image'))
        .filter((img) => img.complete === false || !img.naturalWidth)
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map((img) => new Promise((resolve) => (img.addEventListener('load', resolve, { once: true }), img.addEventListener('error', resolve, { once: true }))));
      return Promise.race([Promise.all(images), new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, IMAGE_WAIT_MS))]).then(() => {
        root.classList.add('mwp-pt-run');
        const anims = list.map((t, i) =>
          t.el.animate([{ transform: `translateX(${t.away(-dir)}px)`, opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, offset: 0.3 }, { transform: 'translateX(0)', opacity: 1 }], { duration: DURATION, delay: i * STAGGER, easing: EASE, fill: 'both' }),
        );
        root.classList.remove('mwp-pt-enter'); // the animations now hold everything hidden until its turn
        return Promise.all(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => {
          anims.forEach((a) => a.cancel());
          root.classList.remove('mwp-pt-run');
        });
      });
    }

    // Left arrow = the one further left (the first in the page if they are stacked)
    function directionOf(link) {
      const arrows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.project-nav_arrow'));
      if (arrows.length < 2) return 1;
      const a = arrows[0].getBoundingClientRect().left;
      const b = arrows[1].getBoundingClientRect().left;
      const i = arrows.indexOf(link);
      if (Math.abs(a - b) < 4) return i === 0 ? -1 : 1;
      return (a < b ? i === 0 : i === 1) ? -1 : 1;

        } catch (e) {}
      });
    }

    // Home page reached via the project back button: jump to the remembered spot (hidden by the head rule) once the layout has settled

      let y = null;
      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem(HOME_RESTORE)) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(HOME_RESTORE);
          y = sessionStorage.getItem(HOME_Y);

      if ('scrollRestoration' in history) history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';

      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const jump = () => {
          if (window.lenis) window.lenis.scrollTo(target, { immediate: true, force: true });

      const a = e.target.closest('a.project-nav_arrow[href]');
      if (!a || a.hasAttribute('download') || (a.target && a.target !== '_self')) return;
      const url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
      if (url.origin !== location.origin || url.pathname === location.pathname) return;
      if (!isFolio(url.pathname) || !isFolio(location.pathname) || reduceMotion || busy) return;

      } catch (err) {}

      busy = false;
      running.forEach((a) => a.cancel());
      running = [];
      root.classList.remove('mwp-pt-run');
      try {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Arriving: read (and clear) the direction, then slide in, or just show the page
    let dir = 0;
    try {
      dir = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem(KEY), 10) || 0;
      sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY);
    } catch (e) {}
    const reveal = () => {
      if (root.classList.contains('mwp-pt-restore')) {
        root.classList.remove('mwp-pt-restore');
        if (!reduceMotion) document.body.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 200, easing: 'ease-out' });
      }
      if (root.classList.contains('mwp-pt-enter')) {

        else root.classList.remove('mwp-pt-enter');
      }

    }

    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {

    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-back]').forEach((link) => {

        const vt = window.MWPViewTransition;
        const nav = window.navigation;

          return;
        }

        let saved = false;
        try {
          saved = sessionStorage.getItem('mwp-home-y') !== null;

    var QUIET_MS = 220; // after a catch, coasting is absorbed until the wheel has been quiet this long (ms),

      absorbStart = 0,
      lastWheel = 0,
      lastDelta = 0,
      glideDone = true;

      return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
    }
    function easeOut(t) {
      return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    }

        out.push(window.scrollY + h.getBoundingClientRect().top + at * window.innerHeight);
      });
      return out;
    }

    // ---- 1. CATCH ----
    function onLenisScroll(l) {
      if (!CATCH || !armed || absorbing || gliding || !active()) return;
      var x = l.animatedScroll,
        target = l.targetScroll;

      dur = Math.min(MAX_GLIDE, Math.max(MIN_GLIDE, dur));

      absorbing = true;
      glideDone = false;

      lastDelta = Infinity;

        duration: dur,
        easing: easeOut,
        force: true,
        onComplete: function () {
          glideDone = true;
        },
      });

        function () {
          glideDone = true;

        return;

    window.addEventListener(
      'wheel',
      function (e) {

          var d = Math.abs(e.deltaY);

          if (glideDone && d > lastDelta * 1.5 + 4) {

            lastWheel = performance.now();

            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            return;
          }
        }
        armed = true;
        gliding = false;
      },
      { passive: false, capture: true },
    );

    // ---- 2. SETTLE ----

      moving = false;
      if (!armed || !down || gliding || absorbing || !active()) return;

        y = window.scrollY,

      if (best === null) return;

      var dur = 0.45 + Math.min(1, Math.abs(best) / (Math.max(AHEAD, PAST) * vh)) * 0.45;
      var l = window.lenis;

        gliding = true;
        l.scrollTo(y + best, {
          duration: dur,
          easing: easeInOut,
          onComplete: function () {
            gliding = false;
          },
        });
        setTimeout(
          function () {
            gliding = false;
          },
          dur * 1000 + 200,
        );
      } else {
        window.scrollTo({ top: y + best, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener(
      'scroll',
      function () {
        var y = window.scrollY;
        if (!moving) {
          moving = true;
          startY = lastY;
        }
        if (y !== lastY) down = y > lastY;
        lastY = y;
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(check, REST_MS);
      },
      { passive: true },
    );
    window.addEventListener(
      'touchmove',
      function () {
        armed = true;
      },
      { passive: true },
    );
    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'PageDown', 'PageUp', ' ', 'Spacebar', 'End', 'Home'].indexOf(e.key) > -1) armed = true;
    });

    (function hook(n) {
      if (window.lenis && window.lenis.on) window.lenis.on('scroll', onLenisScroll);
      else if (n < 100)
        setTimeout(function () {
          hook(n + 1);
        }, 100);
    })(0);
  })();

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';
    if (!('onpageswap' in window)) return; // no cross-document view transitions: these routes just navigate normally

    const FROM_KEY = 'mwp-vt-from';
    const clean = (p) => p.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';
    const pathOf = (url) => clean(new URL(url, location.href).pathname);
    const here = () => clean(location.pathname);
    const isHome = (p) => p === '/';
    const isFolio = (p) => p.startsWith('/portfolio/');
    const morphRoute = (a, b) => (isHome(a) && isFolio(b)) || (isFolio(a) && isHome(b));
    window.MWPViewTransition = { morphRoute: (a, b) => morphRoute(clean(a), clean(b)) };

    const listTitle = (p) => {
      const li = document.querySelector('.folio-list li[data-url="' + p + '"]');
      return li && li.querySelector('.folio-title');
    };
    const inView = (el) => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < window.innerHeight;
    };
    const named = [];
    const name = (el, n) => {
      if (!el) return;
      el.style.viewTransitionName = n;
      named.push(el);
    };
    const clearNames = () => named.splice(0).forEach((el) => (el.style.viewTransitionName = ''));

    // Leaving a page: only home <-> project morphs; everything else navigates normally
    window.addEventListener('pageswap', (e) => {
      if (!e.viewTransition) return;
      const to = e.activation && e.activation.entry && e.activation.entry.url;
      if (!to || !morphRoute(here(), pathOf(to))) {
        e.viewTransition.skipTransition();
        return;
      }
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem(FROM_KEY, here());
      } catch (err) {}
      if (isHome(here())) {
        name(listTitle(pathOf(to)), 'folio-title');
        const preview = Array.from(document.body.children).find((el) => el.style.zIndex === '9998' && el.style.opacity === '1');
        name(preview, 'folio-image');
      }
    });

    // Arriving on a page
    window.addEventListener('pagereveal', (e) => {
      if (!e.viewTransition) return;
      let from = null;
      let restoring = false;
      try {
        from = sessionStorage.getItem(FROM_KEY);
        sessionStorage.removeItem(FROM_KEY);
        restoring = !!sessionStorage.getItem('mwp-home-restore');
      } catch (err) {}
      if (isHome(here())) clearNames(); // leftovers from a back/forward-cache return
      if (!from || restoring || !morphRoute(from, here())) {
        e.viewTransition.skipTransition();
        return;
      }
      if (isHome(here())) {
        const t = listTitle(from);
        if (t && inView(t)) name(t, 'folio-title');
        e.viewTransition.finished.finally(clearNames);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
